Indian Army 10+2 TES 57th Entry Online Form 2026 – Full Details

Join Indian Army (Bhartiya Sena) has released the short notice for the post of 10+2 Technical Entry Scheme Course TES-57th (July 2027) Recruitment 2026. This recruitment has been issued for approx. 90 posts. Online applying process for Army 10+2 TES 56th Recruitment 2026 will start on 14 October 2026 & the candidates can apply till 12 October 2026. Candidates must check the complete details for Indian Army 10+2 TES 56th Entry Recruitment 2026 which has given below.

Important Dates

  • Application Start Date : 14 October 2026
  • Last Date : 12 October 2026
  • Complete Form Last Date : 12 October 2026
  • SSB Interview : As per Schedule

Application Fee

  • No Application Fee For Any Category Candidates

How to Apply Online

  1. Click on the direct Apply Online link in the Important Links section below.
  2. Complete new registration with your Name, Email, and Mobile Number.
  3. Fill the application form with personal, educational, and address details.
  4. Upload scanned photograph, signature, and required certificates.
  5. Pay the applicable examination fee online and download the submission receipt.

Important Links

  • Official Website

Indian Army 10+2 TES 57th Entry Online Form 2026 is an official government examination / recruitment update. Full details and direct links are provided on this page.
